title: In Search of Shares: Benchmarked Ownership, Short Covering, and Price Efficiency
authors: Sanjeev Bhojraj; Yong Yu; Wuyang Zhao
eligible_reason: No DiD design. The main tests are earnings-announcement-level regressions of CARs on earnings-surprise, short-interest and benchmarked-ownership indicators and their interactions (reghdfe car_dgtw05 hiunex hisir hiunex_hisir, absorb(permno + control-rank FE + quarter rank), split by highbmi). The Russell reconstitution test (Table 6) uses May-to-June BMI changes around the reconstitution with a pre/post-June split within a triple interaction, and Table 8 repeats the CAR regressions for guidance and recommendation events. No binary treatment switching on at unit-specific dates.
design_notes: Firm-quarter earnings announcements 1998-2018 (Markit short interest, BMI from Pavlova-Sikorskaya). Cross-sectional interaction design with firm FE and ranked-control FE.
estimators_reported: OLS with firm FE and interaction terms
data_files: BYZ In Search of Shares Data and Code files/shortsqueezeEA_eatest6_5pct.dta
data_files_note: README: 'We provide a randomly chosen 5% of our final dataset'. Markit, Russell membership and BMI data are licensed / obtained from others.
software_notes: SAS for data construction, Stata for tables.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Event-level CAR regressions; not a DiD.
